name: Le Monde
body: A year of HSTS, framing limited to its own origin, and NewsMediaOrganization JSON-LD. Its content security policy exists, but default-src allows any https: source plus 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval'.
lesson: List the script hosts you actually use, then drop 'unsafe-eval'. A policy that allows everything blocks nothing.
summary: www.lemonde.fr scores 72 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 19 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: 5 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 5 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: Claude-SearchBot (Claude search) by Disallow: /, Claude-User (Claude, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /, Amazonbot (Alexa answers) by Disallow: /, DuckAssistBot (DuckAssist answers) by Disallow: /, MistralAI-User (Le Chat, when a person…
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: 3 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /recherche/. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 1 cookie is sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: lmd_a_c. Without HttpOnly: user_session. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /?preferred_lang=fr, /en/?preferred_lang=en and 16 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.

works.title: Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 504 ms
Every page has a meta description
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
